content.rendered:
At Sherwood School District, we know you entrust your children to us each day,
and we do not take that responsibility lightly. The District has worked
diligently over the years to establish comprehensive safety protocols and
emergency procedures in order to help keep our students and staff safe — on a
daily basis, and in the unlikely event of a disaster. Please take a moment to
review this page carefully, as we have included a host of information important
for our parents and community members to know.

CLICK HERE for additional information.
